_meanings:
<ab>N.</ab> of a Yādava, a friend and uncle of Kṛṣṇa. [It was
 he who induced Balarāma and Kṛṣṇa to go to Mathurā and kill Kaṃsa.
 He told the two brothers how their father Ānakadundubhi, the princess
 Devakī and even his own father Ugrasena had been insulted by the iniquitous
 demon Kaṃsa, and told them why he had been despatched to them. Kṛṣṇa
 consented to go and promised to slay the demon within 3 nights, which
 he succeeded in doing.]
